purpose: Name the material from which something is made.
keywords: Material noun + から作る / から作られる.
This sake is made from rice.
We make new paper from old paper.
formation: Material noun + から作る / から作られる.
restrictions: Often used when the source material is transformed and not visually obvious.
mistake: Do not assume から and material で are interchangeable in every context.
